name: Relevance
description: The extent to which the response is relevant to the preceding conversation and context provided.

name: Coherence
description: The logical flow and consistency of the response within the context of the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: The ability of the response to engage the other party in the conversation, prompting further interaction.

name: Creativity
description: The originality and creativity of the response, including the introduction of interesting or novel ideas.

name: Grammar and Clarity
description: The grammatical correctness and clarity of the response, ensuring it is easily understandable.
